scenarios.name: Hero Section Implementation

steps.context: Hero section is the first visual element users see

steps.description: Check that the animated logo or ASCII art is visible and properly styled
steps.context: Logo should replicate the terminal banner aesthetic

steps.description: Confirm the primary tagline 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is displayed along with secondary description
steps.context: Messaging should be clear within 10 seconds of landing

test_cases.expected: Hero section is visible above the fold with logo, tagline, description, and two CTA buttons

test_cases.input: Render Hero component with all props
test_cases.expected: Component renders without errors and displays all required elements

scenarios.name: Features Grid Implementation
scenarios.description: Test the 6-card features grid displays all MirDB capabilities correctly

steps.description: Load the features section and verify all 6 feature cards are displayed
steps.context: Features grid communicates MirDB's value propositions

steps.description: Check each card has icon, title, and description matching requirements
steps.context: Cards: Memcached Compatible, Persistent Storage, High Performance, Configurable, Compaction, Async I/O

steps.description: Confirm cards are arranged in a responsive grid layout
steps.context: Layout should adapt to different viewport sizes

test_cases.expected: 6 feature cards are rendered with icons, titles, and descriptions
Card displays 'Memcached Compatible' title with drop-in replacement description
Card displays 'Persistent Storage' title with LSM-tree architecture description
Card displays 'High Performance' title with skip-list memtable description
Card displays 'Configurable' title with TOML-based configuration description
Card displays 'Compaction' title with automatic minor/major compaction description
Card displays 'Async I/O' title with Tokio for high concurrency description
Cards stack vertically in single column layout

steps.description: Check diagram shows write path (WAL → Memtable → Immutable Memtable → SSTable)

Diagram shows WAL → Memtable → Immutable Memtable → SSTable flow
Diagram shows Memtable → SSTable levels (L0-L7) read path

test_cases.input: View architecture section on mobile viewport
test_cases.expected: Diagram scales appropriately or provides alternative layout for small screens
Diagram is lazy loaded when scrolled into view for performance
